edges.notes: On-premises data centers connect to AWS Transit Gateway.
Transit Gateway routes network traffic to load balancers inside application VPCs.
ELB distributes incoming application requests to Kubernetes pods running on EC2.
Applications hosted on EC2 read and write data to RDS instances.
Kubernetes infrastructure and workloads push logs and metrics to CloudWatch.
